name: candlestick-chart
title: Candlestick Chart
description: OHLC candles with volume bars, a last-price line and a keyboard-friendly crosshair readout, drawn in plain SVG.

props.name: candles
props.description: Candles in time order: id, label, open, high, low, close, volume.

props.name: lastPrice
props.description: Draws a dashed line and a tag at this price, usually the last trade.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Controlled crosshair candle, by id. Pair with onActiveIdChange.

props.name: onActiveIdChange
props.description: Called when the pointer or arrow keys move the crosshair.

props.name: formatPrice
props.description: Formats prices on the axis, tag and legend.

props.name: formatVolume
props.description: Formats volume in the legend (compact by default).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; the chart's text summary starts with it.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Shows the OHLC and volume readout above the plot.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
